objective: Improve Gahyeon production voice conversations: Korean output, English pronunciation, interruption safety, acknowledgement quality, Qwen 1.7B delivery, and latency observability
constraints: Do not deploy until deterministic regressions and the complete AI quality gate pass
Do not interrupt active speech for self-echo, hallucinations, or non-qualifying short input
Do not roll back without explicit rollback authority
Keep standard natural speech available while expressive and code-switched speech use the attested Qwen 1.7B route
Never expose internal prompts or reasoning in text or speech
Preserve explicit user barge-in for meaningful speech
